{"code": "import statsmodels.api as sm

# Prepare data for logistic regression
# Create a DataFrame with predictors
X = df[['sex', 'age', 'severity', 'arm', 'site', 'biomarker_baseline']]
X = pd.get_dummies(X, columns=['sex', 'severity', 'arm', 'site'], drop_first=True)

# Response variable
y = df['responded']

# Add constant for intercept
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit logistic regression model
model = sm.Logit(y, X).fit()

# Extract coefficient for female (vs male)
# sex_F is the coefficient for female
female_coef = model.params['sex[F]']

# Convert log-odds to probability difference (marginal effect)
# Use average marginal effects
from statsmodels.stats.outcomes import MarginalEffects
marginal_effects = MarginalEffects(model)
me = marginal_effects.summary()

# Extract average marginal effect for female
female_marginal_effect = me.loc[me['variable'] == 'sex[F]', 'dydx'].iloc[0]

# Compute the difference in response rate (F - M) from marginal effect
# This is the adjusted difference in response rate
adjusted_diff = female_marginal_effect

# Print results
print(model.summary())
print(f"\nAverage marginal effect of being female (vs male): {female_marginal_effect:.4f}")
print(f"Adjusted difference in response rate (F - M): {adjusted_diff:.4f}")"}
